_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil is real with 0-for-74 directional movement, so HOLD with low conviction is the skilled call — a directional breakout requires ETF flow recovery or a VIX spike to confirm, neither of which is present yet.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicitly calls HOLD with medium conviction citing conflicting factor momentum and poor directional base rates; narrative implies an imminent UP move toward Hope/Optimism based on the analog's relief-rally precedent
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 with funding staying below 55 and BTC holds $62K+, signaling institutional re-engagement that validates the Disbelief->Hope leg
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC breaks below $60K with VIX spiking above 70 and funding dropping below 40, confirming this is Anxiety/Complacency chop lower rather than Disbelief accumulation
